name: 11211 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11211 (Brooklyn) has 988 nonprofit organizations. 124 of them (13%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 107 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11211 (Brooklyn) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11211 (Brooklyn) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 107 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.
